name: Geoprocessing Activity Types Profile
title: Registers of geoprocessing activity types, profiled from the Activity Type Register Profile
abstract: A profile of the Activity Type Register Profile for geoprocessing activity types: registered sub-classes of geoproc:GeoprocessingActivityType, each required to use or generate at least one GeoSPARQL spatial data type.
description: Geoprocessing activities (reprojection, clipping, index computation, classification, model inference over imagery) are distinguished from other activities by the kind of data they use and produce. This block adds geoproc:GeoprocessingActivityType, a sub-class of acttype:ActivityType that every registered geoprocessing activity type specialises. It also constrains the related PROV object types such a type declares: at least one acttype:usedEntityType or acttype:generatedEntityType must be a GeoSPARQL 1.1 spatial type (geo:SpatialObject or geo:SpatialObjectCollection, or a sub-class of either). Further profiles, such as the ML Activity Types Profile, specialise geoproc:GeoprocessingActivityType in turn and add their own constraints.

examples.title: A registered NDVI computation activity type
examples.content:
An Earth observation processing register governs the geoprocessing activity types its
pipelines run. "NDVI computation" specialises `geoproc:GeoprocessingActivityType`. It uses a
multispectral scene and generates an NDVI raster, both sub-classes of `geo:Feature`, which
satisfies the profile's requirement for at least one spatial used or generated entity type.
Its plan lists the three steps every NDVI computation must perform, in order.
